verdict.rationale: Notte publishes a pricing page with a no-card trial and a plan comparison table (e.g., bring-your-own-keys by tier), so some pricing is visible before committing. However, a community user notes the page lists credit allotments without explaining what a credit buys, and nothing in the pack documents rate or concurrency limits. Missing for 10: clear per-task or per-browser-hour unit pricing (what a credit costs or covers), documented rate limits, documented concurrency limits.
